statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. A delayed 05:49 UTC NQ quote was +0.12%; Gulf, oil and rates keep Stress extreme, while persistent one-way NQ structure is not verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold; sustained failure of repair after the 22:00 UTC holiday reopen is the principal escalation checkpoint.
headline: Nasdaq Tail remains WATCH as holiday futures stay contained
body: Reuters reports subdued Wall Street futures in Labor Day trade while Asian technology shares strengthen. A delayed NQ quote at 05:49 UTC was +0.12%. Brent moved above $97 amid U.S.-Iran maritime escalation. Without verified shallow/no-pullback extension or repeated failed retracements, Stress is extreme but current Tail remains 20%.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock-hour assessments are available from finalized ChatGPT history. Tail moved from 22% at 06:00 UTC on September 6 to 24% for much of Sunday, then eased to 20% early September 7 while Stress stayed 99-100% and the mode remained event/whipsaw.
outlookSummary: WATCH is the baseline through the shortened Labor Day session. Tail enters the block band conditionally at the 22:00 UTC reopen only if a directional gap resists repair, pullbacks remain shallow or fail, and extension repeats; orderly two-sided discovery would keep Tail below blocking levels.

A contained Europe handoff keeps Tail at 20 unless shallow pullbacks and directional efficiency begin to align.
European-morning Tail rises only modestly; ordinary retracements or alternating flow keep the regime in WATCH.
Conflicting technology strength and oil/rates pressure keep Stress high; failed NQ repair would be needed to lift Tail materially.
